slice.title: Adversarial symbolic-link output exclusivity fixture
completed: Compared the latest frontier manifest-binding work against the active queue to avoid duplicating the existing source-mutation race fixture.
Recovered the exclusive-create symbolic-link boundary from primary Node.js and Linux open(2) documentation.
Added a deterministic test that pre-positions the manifest output as a symbolic link, expects EEXIST/output_exists, and verifies the protected target remains byte-identical.
Retained an evidence record with source status, uncertainty, claim boundary, and falsification routes.
limits: No authenticated test execution was observable through the available commit workflow lookup.
The fixture targets exclusive-create behavior on the execution platform and does not establish identical symlink semantics across every supported operating system.
No deployment, browser, Vercel, audio, or physical-device claim is made.
slice.safe_next_action: Run the exact-commit Node test suite in an authenticated Linux checkout, retain run evidence, then add bounded platform fixtures only where supported and necessary.
